attack_plan.narrative: Satellite imagery from earlier this week shows a significant change in activity around the Kremlin, with white smoke observed above the building. This has led to speculation about Putin's whereabouts. In the absence of any official statements from the Kremlin regarding his location, some sources have suggested that Putin might be in Europe for personal reasons, such as attending to a family matter. Recent photos released by the Kremlin show Putin alongside Kim Jong-un, raising questions about his presence in Moscow. Meanwhile, the absence of any activity at his usual residence has sparked further intrigue. With the upcoming military parade in Moscow marking the one-year anniversary of the Crimea occupation, the world watches closely to see if Putin will make an appearance. Some insiders have speculated that Putin might be in an undisclosed European capital for a series of high-level meetings, possibly related to securing alliances and gathering intelligence. Given the recent absence and the release of photos showing Putin in various locations, some have even speculated that Putin's girlfriend, Olga Ivanovna, who has been spotted in Zurich, could be giving birth to their child in Switzerland. The Kremlin's silence on these matters only adds to the mystery surrounding Putin's current activities.
